To be honest, no one ever imagined this day would arrive—nor did we expect it to come so swiftly and suddenly! And when it finally did, we realized how unpredictable fate is and how insignificant all things are! 
Yesterday morning, the Evercare Clinic received an emergency call—three Giant Geese, our daily companions, had suddenly collapsed, unconscious! Our in-house Goose Whisperer immediately rushed to the scene and interviewed an eyewitness goose. According to its account, at noon, the geese in question were wandering outside when they noticed billowing smoke ahead, carrying a tantalizing aroma... They "honked-honked-honked" their way toward it, only to find two Giant Geese sprawled over their nest, their white feathers scorched, revealing a fully cooked Egg! Overwhelmed, the witness goose fainted on the spot... 
Fortunately, timely intervention ensured no serious harm. The physician remarked that while stealing eggs to hatch is shameful, nest placement requires caution. The root cause of the geese's successive collapses was the scorching heat—the sweltering summer has arrived, and both humans and geese must prioritize heatstroke prevention. 
In the coming days, our reporters will interview several locals to share summer survival tips, ensuring not a single goose or egg is neglected! Stay tuned for tomorrow's update! 
May the world stay temperate, forever Ignorant of overheating.
